frames.title: Seal arrival
motionFeatures: glyph field gathers toward the arrival anchor

arrivalScale.description: Keeps the arriving seal legible without overpowering the title.

motionOff.summary: The complete seal identity is present immediately.

frames.why: Begin with the community identity before introducing the letter choreography; see the cookbook for the full narrative rationale.

frames.title: Seal migration
motionFeatures: seal travels on the authored path
field leaves space around the seal

migrationArc.description: Balances the seal flight arc against the later K and A convergence.

motionOff.summary: The seal rests at its resolved destination.

frames.why: Migration creates the connective gesture between identity and the K/A construction documented in the cookbook.

frames.title: K / A resolve
motionFeatures: K and A converge around the seal

opacity.description: Keeps the K and A strong while retaining the seal as the central identity.

motionOff.summary: K, seal, and A appear in their resolved positions.

frames.why: The letters resolve around the living seal in the deliberate order preserved by the cookbook.

frames.title: Delayed O resolve
motionFeatures: O resolves after the K and A

delay.description: Protects the readable beat between the K/A arrival and O convergence.

motionOff.summary: The complete KOA mark appears without delay.

frames.why: The delayed O is the authored convergence payoff, not a generic wordmark reveal.

frames.title: Purpose copy
staticFeatures: one readable purpose statement per locale
motionFeatures: copy enters after the identity resolves

copyWidth.description: Keeps localized copy readable without covering the resolved identity.

motionOff.summary: Purpose copy is immediately readable beneath the complete identity.

frames.why: Meaning follows identity so visitors understand what KOA does after recognizing who is speaking.

frames.title: Scroll invitation

cueAlpha.description: Makes the invitation findable without competing with the story.

motionOff.summary: The invitation remains visible without bouncing.

frames.why: The invitation makes the long-form story discoverable while preserving native scrolling.

frames.title: Chapter I · Belonging

hold.description: Preserves a readable pause at the first chapter door.

motionOff.summary: The belonging chapter is fully open.

frames.why: Belonging opens the five-door community story described in the cookbook.

frames.title: Chapter II · Language

numeralAlpha.description: Keeps the glyph-built numeral porous rather than typographically solid.

motionOff.summary: The language chapter is fully open.

frames.why: Language continuity is shown through persistent glyph material rather than decorative symbols.

frames.title: Chapter III · Culture

fieldDensity.description: Retains a living cultural field while leaving the chapter copy unobscured.

motionOff.summary: The culture chapter is fully open.

frames.why: Culture receives a distinct readable door while remaining connected to the same living field.

frames.title: Chapter IV · Service

pathEnergy.description: Adds forward intent without creating frantic motion behind service copy.

motionOff.summary: The service chapter is fully open.

frames.why: Service turns the story outward while keeping action evidence separate from aspirational copy.

frames.title: Chapter V · Future
motionFeatures: field opens toward the partner handoff

opening.description: Creates forward space for the transition from story to participation.

motionOff.summary: The future chapter is fully open.

frames.why: The fifth door prepares the shift from narrated identity to shared future action.

frames.title: Partner handoff
staticFeatures: only approved relationship records may appear
motionFeatures: opposed partner rows when verified data exists

rowTempo.description: Keeps autonomous partner motion slow enough for recognition and focus pausing.

motionOff.summary: Approved partners use a static accessible grid.

frames.why: The public story can hand off to real relationships only when source and logo permission are verified.

frames.title: Final involvement action
motionFeatures: final composition settles rather than looping

actionEmphasis.description: Makes the primary involvement path clear without turning the ending into a sales panel.

motionOff.summary: Every involvement action is immediately available.

frames.why: The film ends with a concrete path to participate after the full KOA story has been read.
